verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Render serves an llms.txt at https://render.com/llms.txt and a markdown docs index at https://render.com/docs.md, both returning HTTP 200. Individual doc pages are also served as .md (e.g. mcp-server.md, cli.md), and Render documents a 'Coding agents' section plus more than 20 official agent skills that give agents Render-specific guidance. missing for 10: independent community corroboration of agents actually consuming llms.txt/markdown docs, evidence of the llms.txt content depth beyond its header.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://render.com/llms.txt # Render
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://render.com/docs.md # Render
They give coding agents Render-specific guidance for deploying, configuring, debugging, monitoring, and scaling your applications.
